pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions are organized into irregular polygons with predominantly angular edges and sharp pixel-level gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with some narrowing on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous topological web. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. The network exhibits high continuity and consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged geometry extending along the cervical ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break or smooth discontinuity is visible in the mane line at the junction between the lower neck and the shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, localized area of severe textural disruption and hyper-pigmented nodular growths is visible along the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent cluster of raised, irregular nodular lesions is present on the upper dorsal surface, indicating significant physical pathology or chronic skin disease.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian subject (oxpecker) is clearly visible perched on the dorsal ridge near the area of textural disruption.
